song.title: Happy Birthday
song.prompt: Sing “Happy Birthday” all the way through, in whatever key feels natural.
song.why: No original recording, so no 'correct' key. Measures each person's comfortable singing key (range baseline) and checks the scoring pipeline.

reference.source: Traditional (public domain). Key is arbitrary; C is only the reference for reporting.
